investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Description: The activity indicates deletion of a security rule within network security group nsg-tallinn-prod-01 by user markus.tamm@globalcorp.ee (Contributor). The action originated from 145.14.39.114 in Tallinn, Estonia, at 09:15 UTC, aligning with typical administrative work hours. Historical context shows a similar NSG modification by the same user during a maintenance window and linked to an approved change, supporting a legitimate administrative change rather than an unauthorized action.
